task_text: Rotate the two Baoding balls around each other in the palm so that each ball follows its own moving target. The targets circle the palm once every 5 s. Keep both balls within about 1.5 cm of their targets for one full orbit of the targets in a row. The episode ends in failure as soon as a ball drops out of the palm, or after 25 s without success, where MyoSuite's target trajectory ends.
